description: Ten public industrial manuals from outside the case, used to test generalization. The PDFs are not in the repository: fetch.py downloads each one from its original URL into eval/external/pdfs/ and checks the sha256 recorded here (files downloaded on 2026-10-30). Pages are 1-based positions in the PDF.

documents.title: TM 5-5060, Maintenance Manual and Parts Catalog, Motorized Air Compressor Model 105 GA, Le Roi Company (War Department, 30 November 1942)
documents.license: US government work in the public domain, marked Public Domain Mark 1.0 on archive.org.
documents.tests: A typewritten 1942 scan with no text layer, so every page goes to OCR; the OCR model's recitation filter refuses its prose pages (36 of the 60 kept), a lubrication chart drawn with labels, and decimal points glued to dot leaders (.015").

excerpt.rule: Only pages 1-60 of the original go into the eval folder, with the same page numbers: PyMuPDF insert_pdf(from_page=0, to_page=59) into a new PDF saved with garbage=3, deflate=True, no_new_id=True (the sha256 above is what PyMuPDF 2.0 writes). OCR of all 229 pages was projected above the budget of the run; pages 1-60 hold the introduction, the specifications and the operator instructions, with the lubrication section on pages 45-51.

documents.title: Bioventing Blower System Operation and Maintenance Manual (Parsons Engineering Science for the US Air Force, DTIC ADA385179, 1996)
documents.license: US Air Force technical report, Distribution Statement A on its cover: approved for public release, distribution unlimited.
documents.tests: A 1996 scan with no text layer: maintenance schedule tables, a manufacturer's service sheet with a striped-background table, and an answer spread over two pages.

documents.title: Ingersoll-Rand, Instructions for Vertical Pumps, classes APM and APS (Cameron Pump Division, 1943)
documents.license: 1943 US commercial publication marked Public Domain Mark 1.0 by its archive.org uploader; not a government work.
documents.tests: A short low-resolution scan with no text layer, and numbers spelled out in words ("three to four drops").

documents.title: SKF bearing maintenance handbook
documents.source_page: SKF's official media CDN (cdn.skfmediahub.skf.com); no catalog page found
documents.license: Public download from SKF, copyright SKF; not redistributed here.
documents.tests: A large catalog (454 pages) with a text layer: long tables split across chunks with a title row above the column header, decimal commas in English text, and photo and drawing pages without text that go to OCR.

documents.title: TM 5-692-1, Maintenance of Mechanical and Electrical Equipment at C4ISR Facilities (US Army Corps of Engineers, 2005)
documents.source_page: https://www.wbdg.org/ (Army Corps of Engineers technical manuals)
documents.license: US government work in the public domain.
documents.tests: A large manual (261 pages) with dozens of similar maintenance-interval tables, one per system, and a near-miss question whose table names the test but gives no value.

documents.title: NORD Drivesystems B 1000 de, Getriebe, Handbuch mit Montageanleitung (edition 2424)
documents.source_page: https://www.nord.com/ (documentation centre; its search returns the PDF)
documents.license: Public download from NORD Drivesystems, copyright NORD; not redistributed here.
documents.tests: A German manual asked in English and Portuguese: maintenance and torque tables, a merged cell split over two rows, drawing pages without text that go to OCR, and the same facts as the Spanish edition.

documents.title: NORD Drivesystems B 1000 es, Reductores, Manual con instrucciones de montaje (edition 2424)
documents.source_page: https://www.nord.com/ (documentation centre; its search returns the PDF)
documents.license: Public download from NORD Drivesystems, copyright NORD; not redistributed here.
documents.tests: The Spanish edition of the same manual: one fact in two documents and two languages, so either one is a valid citation.

documents.title: Leroy-Somer, Moteurs asynchrones triphasés, Installation et mise en service, référence 4850 fr - 2026.05 / i (the server delivers 4850i_fr.pdf)
documents.license: Public download from Nidec Leroy-Somer, copyright Leroy-Somer; not redistributed here.
documents.tests: A French manual asked in Portuguese: storage and regreasing rules that depend on a grease grade the question leaves out (ambiguous).

documents.title: Bonfiglioli, Serie HDP, HDO, Manuale installazione uso e manutenzione (ATEX version, rev. 07_1)
documents.license: Public download from Bonfiglioli, copyright Bonfiglioli; not redistributed here.
documents.tests: An Italian manual asked in English: an oil-change table by temperature with a footnote, headers split mid-word in the text layer, and the slowest text extraction measured (vector drawings).

documents.title: ABB, Low Voltage Motors, Installation, operation and maintenance manual, edition 12/2004 (GB, DE, FR, ES, IT, SE and FI sections in one file)
documents.license: Public download from ABB, copyright ABB; not redistributed here.
documents.tests: One file with the same lubrication table in seven languages, so any of seven pages is a valid citation, and a column header split across rows in the text layer.
